_about: Numbers from each school's own official annual report, loaded into public_records by npm run seed:demo. Every row has the report URL and the sentence or table row it comes from. Only 'formal_reports' and 'investigated' (same school, same year) shape the sample ratings: the share of formal reports the school investigated sets the chance a sample rater answers Yes to 'Did the school take any action after your report?'. Disclosure counts are shown but move nothing. Checked 2026-10-02.
